title: API Keys
description: Manage credentials used to authenticate requests to the QDay API.

banner.message: Keep API keys secure. Store them in environment variables and never commit them to source control.

createModal.title: Create API key
createModal.description: Create a new API key for your integration.

revokeModal.title: Revoke API key
revokeModal.description: Are you sure you want to revoke "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone and any requests using this key will fail.

secretModal.title: API key created
secretModal.description: Copy your secret now — for security reasons, it will not be shown again.
secretModal.warning: Make sure to copy this secret before closing. You won't be able to view it again.
